title: Living pleasure without providing everything
meaning: Open participation supports leisure when providing every pleasure leaves both a stable space without compulsory continual care.
text: Open joy can quietly acquire an appointed organiser. The Sun in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes visible participation: offering pleasures, sharing discoveries and trying things together. The Empress in energy leans towards providing enjoyment to feel needed. The Emperor in emotions gives stability and clear support. Both may appreciate well arranged leisure. Yet its order can hide the tiredness of someone who feels responsible for every pleasant detail and rarely leaves their own wish a place among the preparations.

For example, you arrange a quiet evening with favourite fruit and amusing stories. One keeps bringing plates and extra helpings while already wanting to sit nearby. **Stable enjoyment needs both people’s participation, including the one providing care.** You can leave the table sufficient and freely join the conversation. Its pleasant setting is already there. Endless service is unnecessary for both to feel settled and openly enjoy each other’s company.

The difficulty is seeking reassurance of being needed through further preparation. You provide leisure better while being less present within it. Order becomes an obligation instead of support. A direct wish to sit, listen or choose a favourite flavour restores shared experience. Both can distribute little tasks without testing anyone’s value and preserve stability through free visible participation. The person who arranged something pleasant can receive its pleasure as well.
